data.description: Run one Home Assistant integration in its own container, mirrored to your Home Assistant over MQTT
data.name: HRI Garage

apt_packages.description: Installed at boot, before Home Assistant, for what pip cannot install, such as ffmpeg (HRI_APT_PACKAGES). Names separated by spaces or commas.
apt_packages.name: Debian packages

call_timeout.description: Seconds a service call or command may take before it is reported as a timeout (HRI_CALL_TIMEOUT). Empty means 60.
call_timeout.name: Service call timeout

cookie_secure.description: Mark the session cookie Secure, behind a reverse proxy with TLS (HRI_COOKIE_SECURE).
cookie_secure.name: Secure session cookie

debug.description: Debug logging for the manager, and blocking-call detection (HRI_DEBUG).
debug.name: Debug logging

ha_version_latest.description: Off installs the image's default Home Assistant on a fresh app instead of the newest (HA_VERSION_LATEST).
ha_version_latest.name: Newest Home Assistant on first boot

ingress_users.description: Only these Home Assistant users (their user names) may open the sidebar panel (HRI_INGRESS_USERS). Empty means every Home Assistant user. The app's port keeps its own password.
ingress_users.name: Home Assistant users (sidebar panel)

password.description: Password for the web UI and API on the app's port (HRI_PASSWORD). Empty means no login there. The sidebar panel always uses Home Assistant's login.
password.name: Password
